name: Напольные шипы — иконка
subject: ONE compact fantasy BUILD MENU icon showing ONLY the building from second reference image, three-quarter composition, retain its wood/steel/brass materials and characteristic silhouette. SECOND image defines structure, NOT voxel rendering: convert to crisp rich 2D PIXEL ILLUSTRATION like first image. No construction arrows, ground, NPC, tool overlay, text or surrounding scene. ONE square floor SPIKE TRAP module: three broad dark-oak planks on two cross-bindings and exactly a 3-by-3 arrangement of NINE thick iron spikes. Each spike tapers via large cubic stair steps, not smooth pyramids, same nine spikes in every view. Gray steel tips and large brass rivets, wooden substrate is INTRINSIC trap structure, not landscape. No extra surrounding floor, ground or base pedestal.
caption: Пиксельная иконка меню строительства, согласованная с пятиракурсным референсом этой постройки.
